subject.title: [Bug]: macOS onboarding rejects a logged-in Codex CLI on fresh installs

question: Should the open hardening PR remain the fix path for this P0 macOS Codex onboarding blocker, or should maintainers split a narrower Codex runtime-provisioning repair first?
rationale: The root cause is narrow and source-reproducible, but this issue has a protected maintainer label and an open linked PR with broader auth/setup changes, so automation should not choose the landing shape by itself.

options.title: Review linked repair PR
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102637 as the active fix path and close this issue after it merges with acceptable upgrade proof.

options.title: Split a narrow repair
options.body: Land only the pre-test Codex runtime provisioning fix first, then handle the broader onboarding polish separately.

options.title: Keep open for manual ownership
options.body: Leave this issue assigned while a maintainer decides whether the broader PR scope is worth the compatibility and auth-provider risk.

recommendation.title: Review linked repair PR
recommendation.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102637 as the active fix path and close this issue after it merges with acceptable upgrade proof.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the current assignee and the strongest history owner for the macOS onboarding/Codex setup-inference path.
